description: This file defines the ArgumentsResolver class in the Drupal Component Utility namespace, responsible for resolving arguments to pass to callables, including handling type hints, default values, and unresolved arguments.

classes.name: ArgumentsResolver
classes.description: A class that resolves arguments for callables based on provided scalars, objects, and wildcards, handling type hints and default values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resolver with scalars, objects, and wildcards.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns an array of arguments for a given callable.

methods.name: getArgument
methods.description: Resolves the value for a specific parameter, considering type hints, scalars, wildcards, and default values.

methods.name: getReflector
methods.description: Creates a reflection object for the given callable, whether it's a function or method.

methods.name: handleUnresolvedArgument
methods.description: Handles cases where an argument cannot be resolved, throwing an exception.
